name: Pixel toys
description: Hellfire (the PlayStation Doom fire, in three palettes), fireworks, a fountain, a waterfall, a starfield, Matrix rain, ripples, blobs, a plasma and Life, each computed cell by cell in JS and written straight into the frame in the 8-bit palette mode. Swipe for the next one; pick the effect, the cell size and an FPS counter in the scene's settings. For LCD and HDMI frames that render many times a second.
